summary: Paint oversized native transcript records from a bounded preview

replay.detail: No replay cursor or spool format changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, migrations or schema versions change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: A native transcript record larger than 256 KiB, such as a large tool output, enters the conversation timeline as a preview whose long strings keep only their first 8 KiB. The timeline no longer holds or copies the full body. Every block of such an entry carries a continuation, and opening it reads the complete record from the owner. The continuation omits its size because the preview never measured the complete value; the content chunks report the exact size.

downtime.detail: No coordinated restart or startup work is added.

manual.detail: No configuration or manual action is required.

recovery.detail: No graph recovery or repair is required.
